events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in the UK in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – an album that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity. Which track still moves you the most?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's enduring hits
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to Sting! From The Police classics to his incredible solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable tunes. What's your all-time favourite Sting or Police track?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple revolutionised portable music listening with the release of its first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the original iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, the world's most famous secret agent is still captivating audiences. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring influence
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's your most cherished John Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The inimitable British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's comedic genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, his unique brand of humour is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's impact
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from this iconic double album is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game, showcasing their evolving sound. What's your go-to track from this influential album?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's lasting peace message
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally. What aspect of his legacy resonates most with you today?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician, artist, and innovator David Bowie, born David Robert Jones, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's artistic genius
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie's incredible artistry and constant reinvention left an indelible mark on music and culture. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis's enduring reign
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His impact on music and pop culture is simply unmatched. What's your favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and songwriter, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page's guitar mastery
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are legendary. What's the ultimate Jimmy Page guitar moment for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive-voiced rock and pop icon, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's timeless hits
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! With a career spanning decades, his voice is instantly recognisable. What's your favourite Rod Stewart singalong?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness frontman's charm
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! The ultimate showman, he's given us countless Two Tone anthems. What's your favourite Madness track to get you skanking?
